title: Silas and the Summit
author: Noor Hartwell
blurb: Gideon Whitlock, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
